subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story.
stimulus: (a) There she became a teacher of a school in Kolkata. (b) She swore to dedicate her life to the cause of helpless and poor people and soon her activity for the service of mankind spread all over the world. (c) She was on her heels for selfless service of mankind even at her old age. (d) In recognition to her servicat Ratna Award in the following year. (e) She was one of those people who dedicated their lives to the service of mankind. (f) When she was eighteen, en, she decided to be a nun and came to Kolkata. (g) She was born in Yugoslavia in 1919. (h) You heard the name of Mother Teresa.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 h e g f a b d c
